# כל שירות (Kol Sherut) — full reference

> Expanded companion to https://www.kolsherut.org.il/llms.txt. Kol Sherut is Israel's open database and search engine for public social services, operated by Kol Zchut (כל זכות) with support from the Israeli Ministry of Justice and the National Digital Agency.

Site: https://www.kolsherut.org.il/
Contact: info@kolsherut.org.il
Language: Hebrew (עברית), with a dedicated Arabic section (العربية)
Status: beta — data is largely imported automatically and may be incomplete or out of date

## What the platform does

Kol Sherut aggregates and indexes thousands of social services across Israel — services provided by government ministries, municipalities, NGOs, health funds and other organizations. Users can search by free text, filter by life situation, response type, target audience and location, and view results on an interactive nationwide map or as a list. Each service has a card page with description, target audience, eligibility, contact details, branches and locations.

## URL scheme

Every path below is relative to https://www.kolsherut.org.il

- `/` — homepage: free-text search, main categories, popular topics
- `/?sq={query}` — free-text search results for `{query}` (URL-encoded, Hebrew or Arabic)
- `/{response}` — all services of one response type, e.g. `/housing`, `/health`
- `/{situation}/{response}` — a situation and response combination, e.g. `/seniors/housing`, `/low_income/food`
- `/{situation}` — all services for one life situation, e.g. `/infants`, `/mental_illness`
- `/by-{audience}` — filter by target audience segment
- `/bsnf-{situation}` — filter by an additional situation
- `/p/card/c/{serviceId}` — a single service card
- `/map` — site map: the full catalog of indexed responses and life situations
- `/sitemap.xml` — sitemap index covering static pages, service cards, taxonomy pages, homepage topics, services and organizations

Further filters are applied as query parameters: `lf` (location), `rf` (response), `sf` (situation), `by` (audience), `bsnf` (secondary situation).

## Response taxonomy — what a service provides

Human services (שירותים אנושיים), health (בריאות), care (טיפול), education (חינוך), legal (משפטי), employment (עבודה), housing (דיור), community services (שירותים קהילתיים), goods (מוצרים), financial assistance (כסף), emergency services (חירום), culture and sport (תרבות וספורט), food (מזון).

## Situation taxonomy — who a service is for

- Target audiences: military and veteran status, citizenship, criminal history, deprivation, education, household status, housing status, income level, sector, sexual orientation, survivor status
- Health: mental health conditions, substance dependency, disabilities, physical health conditions
- Age groups: infants, children, teens, young adults, adults, seniors
- Languages: Arabic, Russian, Amharic, Tigrinya, French, English and more
- Also: employment status, gender, community, life events, government-recognized statuses

## Geographic coverage

Services are indexed across all of Israel, including Gush Dan (Greater Tel Aviv), the Jerusalem area, northern Israel, southern Israel, and nationwide services (שירות ארצי). Users can search by city, by region, or from their current GPS location.

## Data sources

- [GuideStar Israel](https://www.guidestar.org.il/) — the national NGO and nonprofit registry, and the main upstream source
- Government ministries and agencies
- [Open Eligibility](https://github.com/kolzchut/openeligibility) — the taxonomy used to classify responses and situations

## Partners

- [Kol Zchut](https://www.kolzchut.org.il/) (כל זכות) — the operating organization
- [Ministry of Justice](https://www.gov.il/he/departments/ministry_of_justice/govil-landing-page)
- [National Digital Agency](https://www.gov.il/he/departments/national-digital-agency/govil-landing-page)
- Prime Minister's Office — Government and Society Division
- Government ICT Authority — Ready Government unit
- Corporate Authority and GuideStar
- Ministry of Welfare and Social Security
- Ministry of Health
- Ministry of Education

## How organizations add services

- NGOs and nonprofits: enter the service data on [GuideStar Israel](https://www.guidestar.org.il/) — it is imported into Kol Sherut automatically
- Other organizations: email info@kolsherut.org.il with the organization name, the services provided, and contact details
- Anyone can report a missing or incorrect service from the site itself

## Disclaimer

Kol Sherut provides general information only and does not give individual advice. Kol Zchut Ltd. (a public benefit company) is not responsible for the content displayed on the site. The information is general, largely sourced automatically from various databases, and may not be complete, accurate or up to date. Use of the site is at the user's sole responsibility. Government support does not imply governmental responsibility for the site's operation or content. The site is intended for all genders.
